scope: Actual Unity command fixtures. No color changes, retouching, motion interpolation or art substitution. Exact nearest-neighbor2x local crops; full GameViews unchanged. Timeline starts at each first available capture and holds each image until the next measured timestamp. The last frame holds to the recorded case completion. GIF has10ms timing quantization; MP4 measured against recorded schedule. Capture sampling can miss detail between frames and does not establish subjective comfort.
